title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - YAROSLAVSKY) relative to funding for community beautification efforts in Council District 8.
text:
[Council File 26-1596]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - YAROSLAVSKY) relative to funding for community beautification efforts in Council District 8.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $500,000 from AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281208 (CD 8 Redevelopment Projects - Services), $299,150 from the Council District 8 Public Benefit Trust Fund No. 49F; AND, TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $138,758 from the General City Purposes Fund No. 100/56, Account No. 0708 (CD 8 Community Services) [TOTAL: $937,908] to Board of Public Works Fund No. 100/74, Account No. 3040 (Contractual Services) for community beautification efforts in Council District 8, to be coordinated by the following organizations as noted in the Motion, attached to the Council file.
2. INSTRUCT and AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works (Office of Community Beautification) to prepare, process and execute the necessary documents with and/or payments to the Los Angeles Conservation Corps, Gang Alternative Program, and Coalition for Responsible Community Development, or any other agency or organization, as appropriate, utilizing the above amount, for the above purpose, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
3. AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works (Office of Community Beautification) to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
